hero.title: Helping Citizens Navigate Life
hero.subtitle: An official government web app guiding Slovaks step-by-step through life events.

client.title: Client
client.description: Ministry of Investment, Regional Development and Informatization

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Citizens didn't know what steps, documents, or offices they needed for life events. Process was fragmented and confusing.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Centralized, clear, digital assistant for life situations. Library of life situations guides tailored for each citizens.

role.description1: This project began at a hackathon that my team and I attended.
role.description2: During the event, we were noticed by MIRRI SR, who appreciated our idea.
role.description3: After the hackathon, we signed a contract, and I took on the role of frontend developer. What started as a simple hackathon idea eventually grew into a full government contract.

hero.title: Connecting Investors with Košice Region
hero.subtitle: A regional web platform designed to attract Slovak and foreign investors to Košice Region and support sustainable growth.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: The Košice Self-Governing Region needed a modern and transparent way to present investment opportunities. Existing information was scattered, unclear, and often inaccessible for international investors.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: A web portal that showcases investment opportunities in Košice Region, enables investors to discover suitable sites/projects, get verified local data, and quickly contact region representatives.

role.description1: This project started at a hackathon organized for the city of Košice, aimed at attracting more investors to the region.
role.description2: After the hackathon, the Košice region reached out to me with an offer to work as a UX consultant for the company that would bring our idea into production.
role.description3: While my original concept remained intact, my team contributed as technical consultants. My contract with the Košice region lasted one year and concluded after the successful deployment of the project into production.

persona1.painPoints: Investment data is fragmented across multiple sites and hard to verify
persona1.goals: Discover the best locations for business expansion in Košice Region

persona2.subtitle: Interested in expanding operations
persona2.needs: Insights into local market trends, workforce availability, and infrastructure
persona2.painPoints: Time-consuming to gather and cross-check data manually
persona2.goals: Gain confidence in investment decisions backed by trusted data

reflection.bulletPoint1: How to turn a hackathon prototype into a real product for a public institution.
reflection.bulletPoint2: The importance of consistent communication between the office and the IT supplier.

about.title: Designing and building digital products that solve real-world problems.
about.description: I’m Lucas Ligas, a UI/UX designer and frontend developer from Slovakia. I’ve worked on a government project and led my team Incomodum to multiple hackathon wins — with our ideas now implemented across Slovakia.
about.description2: I’m passionate about design thinking and creating digital solutions that are both functional and meaningful.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: I first discovered UI/UX and frontend development in high school, where I also interned at Wezeo.
experience.description2: In my third year, I co-founded Incomodum, a team that competed in five Slovak hackathons, winning 1st place once, 2nd place three times, and 3rd place once.
experience.description3: During one of these events, I was invited to work as a UI/UX consultant for the Košice Self-Governing Region.
